title: Workflow Roles — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: An approver role, such as Payroll Officer. Employees are given roles on their record, and a step whose Approver Person is Person goes to everyone holding its role.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Required. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: WorkflowRoleGroup
fields.rules: Required. One of: None, Company, Department, Branch, CostCenter.
fields.html:
What it is. A default organisation scope for the role.

Why it matters. Not read at present. The scope that narrows approvers is the one on each step.

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: OrgLevel
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Organization Unit Type master data.
fields.html:
What it is. An organisation unit level for the role.

Why it matters. Not read at present.
